IT Stocks in Focus Ahead of Q2 Earnings Amid AI Disruption

Major Indian IT companies including TCS, Infosys, and Wipro are in focus as the second quarter earnings season begins. Analysts are anticipating the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) disruption on their performance. Other companies like Anand Rathi, KEC International, NCC, and BEML are also among stocks to watch.
